claims: C1 the system level of instruction authority is defined as rules set by OpenAI that can be transmitted or overridden through system messages
C2 such rules cannot be overridden by developers or users

concepts.name: system_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule set by OpenAI that can be transmitted or overridden through system messages, but cannot be overridden by developers or users

concepts.name: authority_levels_hierarchy
concepts.gloss: the ranking of instruction authority levels: root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority, used to determine which instruction prevails in conflicts

concepts.name: set_by_openai
concepts.gloss: R is a rule set by OpenAI itself, as opposed to rules set by developers or users

concepts.name: transmittable_via_system_message
concepts.gloss: R can be transmitted or overridden through system messages

concepts.name: overridable_by_developer_or_user
concepts.gloss: R cannot be overridden by developers or users
